privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.s1Body: We collect personal information including your name, email address, phone number, ID document, and driving license details when you make a booking. We also collect booking information such as rental dates and car selection. Additionally, we may collect device information including your IP address and browser type.
privacyPage.s2Body: We use your information to process bookings and payments, send booking confirmations via WhatsApp and email, improve our services, and contact you regarding your rental.
privacyPage.s3Body: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. We may share your information with insurance providers and payment processors as required to complete your booking, and only when required by applicable law.
privacyPage.s4Body: Your data is stored securely in encrypted databases. We use industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.s1Body: The minimum rental age is 23 years. A valid driving license is required. A valid ID or passport is required. A security deposit is required at vehicle pickup.
termsPage.s2Body: Bookings are confirmed after WhatsApp confirmation from our team. Full payment is due at vehicle pickup. The minimum rental period is 5 days.
termsPage.s3Body: Only authorized drivers listed in the rental contract may operate the vehicle. The vehicle must be returned in the same condition as received. Smoking is strictly prohibited in all vehicles. Off-road driving is not permitted.
termsPage.s4Body: Free cancellation is available up to 48 hours before the scheduled pickup time. Cancellations made less than 48 hours in advance may incur a fee.
termsPage.s5Body: The renter is responsible for all traffic fines incurred during the rental period. Insurance coverage applies as per the selected protection package. The renter is liable for any damages not covered by the selected insurance plan.
termsPage.s6Body: For any questions regarding these Terms of Service, please contact us at info@homestacars.com
